title: Daily DirectDebit Transactions
description: Daily volume and value of DirectDebit transactions.

fields.name: volume
fields.title: Transaction Volume
fields.description: [Integer] Number of DirectDebit transactions for the date.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Transaction Value (RM)
fields.description: [Float, RM] Value of DirectDebit transactions for the date in Ringgit Malaysia (RM).

methodology:
This data is derived from transactional records of recurring payments settled through the DirectDebit recurring payment scheme operated by PayNet, Malaysia's national payments network and central financial infrastructure. DirectDebit transactions are recorded in real time as they occur through participating banks' systems, where customers authorise recurring debits to billers or merchants via an eMandate or authorisation form. Each transaction is captured centrally by PayNet's infrastructure.

For the purpose of publication via data.gov.my, PayNet conducts the aggregation and provides only the daily totals; no transaction-level data is ever disseminated outside PayNet's systems.
caveat: This dataset is provided with the highest practical timeliness (updated by 2am daily for data up to the previous day) due to its high potential for use in nowcasting and forecasting models. However, there may occasional revisions to ensure eventual consistency with the monthly payment statistics published by the Central Bank of Malaysia (BNM).
